text:
emma: FYI CloudHub reviewer emailed— they paused our marketplace approval. They need explicit KMS export rules, SCIM schema examples, and a sanitized audit log sample. CipherWorks legal promised items 'next week' but reviewer wants earlier.

raj: Do we have a fallback plan if CipherWorks can't provide the audit sample quickly? CloudHub insisted on a log schema to validate compliance.

lena: We can generate a mocked log using the exact schema they want. CipherWorks said schema is standard: lifecycle events (create/import/wrap/unwrap/destroy) + actor id + key id + timestamp + HSM-module-id. I'll draft a sample and flag that it's sanitized.

carlos: Legal: we must label any mock logs as "sanitized sample" and include a statement: "production logs are partner-managed and provided on request under NDA." Also need to confirm whether CipherWorks allows us to reference their FIPS/CC certificate in marketplace copy.

mika: Technical quick-check: can CipherWorks support SCIM custom attributes for team_id and role_level? CloudHub wants group->role mapping to auto-provision admin users. If not, we can document a SCIM post-provision hook.

emma: Sophie (CipherWorks contact) replied briefly: "We can provide FIPS cert and attestation PDF but need our legal to sign the co-marketing addendum. SCIM supports core schema + enterprise extension for groups. Audit logs can be exported as JSON lines. Sample will be available after legal signoff."

sophie: @emma thanks, yes working on it. I can share the attestation PDF and a sample sanitized log once legal signs the addendum. Expected end of week.

marketplace-bot: CloudHub ticket CH-48721 created. Reviewer note: "If partner-managed keys are in scope, marketplace entry must state "partner-managed" and link to partner attestation."

raj: Proposed marketplace copy snippet: "CipherWorks-managed HSM for customer keys (BYOK import supported; keys are non-exportable from HSM unless wrapped per partner policy). See partner attestation for details." Thoughts?

lena: Slight wording tweak: "CipherWorks-managed HSM (BYOK import supported). Key export and wrap policies are defined by CipherWorks; see partner attestation." Keeps us neutral.

carlos: Add legal-safe parenthetical: "(Redwood does not control partner key export policies)."

mika: For SCIM we should include an example mapping block in the listing docs. I'll paste a minimal example here for the reviewer:

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@example.com",
  "emails": [{"value":"alice@example.com","type":"work"}],
  "groups": ["redwood-admins"],
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": {"department":"security","manager":"bob"}
}
```

lena: Nice. Also include a group mapping example:

```
group -> role mapping
"redwood-admins" -> "admin"
"redwood-devs" -> "developer"
```

emma: Action list recap: 1) emma get attestation + cert PDF from CipherWorks legal (Sophie) by EOW. 2) carlos draft co-marketing + security addendum and add the NDA clause for sanitized logs. 3) mika assemble SCIM/SSO feature matrix and sample mapping (done). 4) lena update marketplace copy with neutral language. 5) raj prepare fallback wording for listing if docs delayed.

carlos: I'll also add a short annex that disambiguates Redwood SLAs vs partner SLAs and include exact phrasing for the marketplace: "Availability claims refer to Redwood services; partner-managed components are subject to partner SLA."

emma: Reviewer gave an alternative: accept a signed letter from CipherWorks security lead in lieu of the full attestation for initial listing. Sophie, can you escalate for a signed letter?

sophie: I'll ask security to furnish a scoped letter (one-page) certifying FIPS status and export policy. Might be faster.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: If CloudHub needs immediate PR copy for embargo scheduling, provide draft with the line: "pending partner attestation" to avoid delays.

raj: Also ask CipherWorks for a brief integration test vector: a key import command example and a sample KMS response (sanitized). Reviewer used that to validate API parity.

emma: I'll request the test vector and the signed letter today. Will update here with attachments. Target to clear CH-48721 this week.

lena: Tentative announcement headline idea: "Redwood + CipherWorks bring hardware-backed BYOK to CloudHub marketplace" (embargo when attestation in).

emma: Thanks all — looping in on any vendor replies. Will post final items (attestation, sample log, signed letter) or status by 2170001460.
